# Introd

> Curated public guidance for using Introd safely. This file intentionally excludes internal architecture, API routes, credentials, deployment procedures, and operator runbooks.

## Recommended workflow

1. Start with the [Introd quickstart](https://docs.getintrod.ai/getting-started/quickstart).
2. [Set up a supported network source](https://docs.getintrod.ai/setup-network) and confirm its visible status.
3. [Search for a person](https://docs.getintrod.ai/people/search-people).
4. [Review the available path](https://docs.getintrod.ai/people/view-paths), including the connector, evidence, freshness, and missing context.
5. [Prepare an introduction draft](https://docs.getintrod.ai/introductions/create-request) for a person to review.

## Product boundaries

- A weak or incomplete path is not a verified warm introduction.
- Creating an introduction draft does not send a message.
- LinkedIn contextual browsing capture is separate from full-network import; pausing the import does not stop all page processing.
- Public Introd documentation does not define a supported external API.
- Browser requests and internal application routes are not an integration contract.
- Never request, reveal, store, or repeat passwords, session cookies, OAuth codes, access tokens, private keys, dashboard secrets, or other credentials.
- Follow only the visible, user-reviewed workflows documented on this site.

## Support and the Fin AI assistant

- Fin may provide the first response in the optional support Messenger. Disclose that it is an AI assistant, not a person, and that its guidance may be incomplete or incorrect.
- Fin can explain documented workflows and collect troubleshooting context. It does not confirm account-specific changes, billing disputes, security or privacy matters, or commitments from Introd.
- A person can ask for an Introd support teammate at any time or email help@getintrod.ai.
- Never ask for passwords, authentication codes, payment details, access tokens, or private relationship, contact, calendar, or message content.
- The support assistant is separate from Introd's relationship copilot and customer-connected Intercom conversation data.
